name: Docling Standard Pipeline
mechanism: Combines deterministic PDF parsing with configurable OCR, layout analysis, reading order and table-structure recognition in an inspectable local pipeline.
use_when: Mixed born-digital and scanned PDFs need one local pipeline
Tables, hierarchy and page provenance matter
avoid_when: Only plain clean text is needed at maximum throughput
Hard handwriting or chart semantics dominate the corpus
expected_effects: Diagnosable OCR, layout and table stages
failure_modes: OCR errors cascade into layout and tables
Reading order fails on unusual page designs
